stories.title: A494 at Deeside records busiest year in DfT figures with 64,710 vehicles a day
stories.summary: The A494 at Deeside carried an average of 64,710 vehicles a day in 2025, the highest figure for that stretch in Department for Transport (DfT) records going back to 2000. stories.title: More than half of over-50s in Wales struggling with cost of living, Age Cymru survey finds
stories.summary: More than half of over-50s who took part in Age Cymru’s annual survey say they are struggling with the cost of living, up from 9 per cent in 2020. stories.title: Buckley gets one of ten new Network Rail weather stations on railway radio masts
stories.summary: Buckley is one of ten places across Wales and the Borders where Network Rail has fitted weather stations to railway radio masts to help it respond to storms. stories.summary: A Hawarden woman who dreaded reading aloud in class because of dyslexia now co-runs an employee benefits firm she describes as a multi-million pound business. stories.title: Flintshire loses 290 of its smallest businesses in three years
stories.summary: The number of very small businesses in Flintshire has fallen by 290 in three years, even as the county bucked a Wales-wide drop in established firms.
